thread:
julia: Quick PSA — I did a tiny run to Little Red Bakery and left a mixed bagel box on the kitchen island (1pm). Please help yourselves. Theres a sticky note saying counted flavors.
marc: Legend. which ones are in there? trying to avoid mystery poppy seeds 🙂
sam: Thanks julia! FYI someone spilled syrup on the south counter by the espresso machine — towels on the sink but still a bit tacky. I can wipe in 10.
lina: @sam appreciate it — its been attracting crumbs. Can whoever spilled put a sign or clean next time? :sweat_smile:
ash: on it, grabbing spray now. blue cabinet, top shelf. left a post-it with a tiny mop emoji.
kevin: If anyones heading out later, can you also pick up an almond milk carton and a gluten-free bagel? Im out and owe @julia $6 for the box. cash/venmo?
julia: @kevin you can venmo me (julia-office). I put a sticky with quantities in the box so grab what you need.
marc: Poll idea: weekly bakery drop from Little Red on Wednesdays? react :+1: for yes, :-1: for no, :shrug: if occasionally. Saves last-minute runs.
lina: :+1: for weekly, their croissants are dangerously good.
sam: :+1:, but can we alternate with a savory-only week? my dentist hates me otherwise.
kevin: :-1: I vote for spontaneous chaos.
kitchen-bot: Reminder from Kitchen Ops — please label any food you put in the fridge that isn't communal. "Name / Date / Keep?" is enough. Unlabeled perishables older than 4 days will be cleared on Fridays.
julia: also left two tubs of vegan butter (labelled). if youre grabbing one, please only take one so morning people get some.
ash: cleaned the syrup spot. left the rag to dry on the towel rack and a tiny note: "sorry sticky — cleaned!" :broom:
marc: ok team — responses are trending :+1:. If it stays this way well try a Wednesday baker next week. Thanks for the quick cleanups and the bagels :)
kevin: Anyone else want me to pick up oat creamer instead of almond next time? shout now or forever hold your nose.
sam: oat creamer please. thanks!
lina: Ill bring biodegradable napkins tomorrow to cut down on paper towel use.
julia: perfect. last note: if you label a personal container with "KEEP" please also include a date; otherwise it may get donated to the mysterious office snack pile.
marc: Amen to the mysterious pile.
kevin: thumbs up. next time Ill hide the gluten-free bagel in the top shelf so it survives lunch.
julia: End thread — bagels vanishing fast :banana:
